name: codex-mcp-bridge
description: Connect ChatGPT to your own Codex Desktop projects and conversations.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to your own Codex Desktop computer. List saved projects, read conversations, start an authorized task, or continue unfinished work. Each account pairs its own connector; local project roots and account identities are verified before dispatch. Requires Node.js 22+, Windows or macOS, signed-in Codex Desktop and Claude Desktop, the native relay, and a running outbound connector. Queued requests return an operation ID. Interrupted sends are never automatically repeated.
